caption:
Hate fractions? Graph both sides.

Type y = left side and y = right side in Desmos. The x-value where they cross solves the equation.

Comment your answer before you check.
tiktok_caption: Fraction equation? Graph each side in Desmos and click the crossing.

youtube.title: Solve Fraction Equations in Desmos by Graphing Both Sides
youtube.description: Graph each side of a fraction equation as its own line and read the x-value of the crossing. SAT-style practice question (original).
